reason: Guides a Main-owned bounded read-only catalog whose directory is learned from official Pi state, with explicit lifecycle and typed failure ownership.
Guides discriminated scope, bounded metadata/cursor schemas, opaque selections, and validation at IPC boundaries.
The catalog selection flows from Main filesystem metadata through preload/store into local Pi process replacement.
Keeps the catalog as minimal navigation glue without copying Pi session path resolution or adding a parallel database.
Defines the current official Pi RPC/session boundary and the justified read-only listing exception.
